# HRP Rule 1 - Stay immersed in the world High roleplay means the round is treated as a real, continuous experience for your character. Your first instinct should always be "what would my character do?", not "what is the optimal play?".
- Keep local OOC (LOOC) to a minimum. Use LOOC only for genuine clarifications, not conversation. - Do not narrate game mechanics, meta concepts, or admin/developer topics in character. - React to events with the weight your character would actually feel. Injury, death, and danger are not routine.
## Examples Things you should not do: - Respond to a coworker's death with "gg" or by immediately looting them without reaction. - Say "lol the AI is bolting doors again" over the radio. - Use LOOC to chat about your day while a scene is happening around you.
Things you could do instead: - Have your character freeze, call for help, or process the shock before acting. - Report "The AI has sealed the doors, something's wrong, stay calm" in character. - Save OOC chatter for the lobby or after the round.
